EXPLANATION: Validate the referrer URL to prevent open redirection vulnerabilities by ensuring it belongs to the same host before redirecting.
```python
def toggle_secure_mode():
    init_session()
    session["secure_mode"] = not session.get("secure_mode", False)
    session.modified = True

    from urllib.parse import urlparse
    ref = request.referrer
    safe_ref = ref if ref and urlparse(ref).netloc == request.host else None
    return redirect(safe_ref or url_for("index"))
```
